sourceNote: Manually reconciled contract rows using NHL team announcements and PuckPedia season breakdowns. Signing-bonus fields are intentionally omitted from the simulation. Six additional 2026-27 contracts were reconciled against PuckPedia and club announcements on 2026-11-01. Signing bonuses are excluded from the simulation salary field; performance bonuses remain separately represented. Four additional Anaheim Ducks 2026-27 salary breakdowns reconciled against PuckPedia player contract pages and NHL/club announcements on 2026-11-02; base salary is kept separate from cap hit and signing bonuses are excluded. Eight additional Anaheim 2026-27 base salaries, cap hits and terms were reconciled against PuckPedia player contract breakdowns and NHL club announcements on 2026-11-02; signing bonuses are excluded from the salary field. Twelve Chicago Blackhawks 2026-27 base salaries and cap hits reconciled against PuckPedia player contract breakdowns on 2026-11-02; signing bonuses excluded from base salary. Nine Detroit Red Wings 2026-27 base salaries and cap hits reconciled against PuckPedia player contract breakdowns on 2026-11-02; signing bonuses excluded from base salary.
